narrative.intro: Airbus Us Space and Defense obligated $253M in federal contract funds in FY2026 to date. The company received 8 awards so far, with an average award size of $31.6M. Obligations fell 22.6% year over year. Fiscal-year obligations have varied: FY21 was $220M, FY22 was $255M, FY23 was $356M, FY24 was $348M, FY25 was $327M, and FY26 is $253M. The Department of Defense is the primary buyer, accounting for $253M in obligations. Smaller agency purchases include the Department of Justice at $156K and the Department of Homeland Security at $12.5K. Airbus Us Space and Defense’s principal market in FY2026 to date is Other Support Activities for Air Transportation at $253M. Secondary markets include Computer and Computer Peripheral Equipment and Software Merchant Wholesalers at $156K, Other Aircraft Parts and Auxiliary Equipment Manufacturing at $12.5K, and Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) at $500.
